decision: Scans: full car (1a2jko...) + Bomex state scans: bumper only, bumper+hood removed, bumper grille removed, gas door open, hood open, rear wing removed, side mirrors removed
why: Brief's allowed list. Skipped 'Side Mirrors', 'Air Ducting', 'Upper/Lower Grille' (likely Bomex CAD/aftermarket parts), 'crash foam removed' (not on the allowed list) and the 2023 400Z.blend

decision: Canonical frame: levelled Artec frame (tools/level.py: PCA yaw, nose to -Y, tyre-contact plane horizontal, 1.39 deg) -> ive prep car.json; every state/part prepped --like car.json
why: Full-car STL was exported diagonal in XY with no ground; one rigid transform applied to all scans keeps them registered (lesson: never re-normalise separately)

decision: All 7 Bomex state scans used at identity in the car frame (no ICP)
why: Nearest-surface distance on overlap p50 1.4-1.7 mm (mirrors/wing/gas door), bumper p50 3.8 mm; red-over-silver renders z-fight on shared panels (check/reg_all.jpg). Same Artec frame: identical x-min clip -2526 mm in full car and rear states
Raw had a debris island ahead of the nose (4.63 m); 400Z spec 4,379 mm is the sanity check

decision: Parts cut by diffing the full car against each 'removed' state (tools/parts.py: >10 mm from state, zone, connected to a seed): hood (vs Hood Open), trunk spoiler (vs Rear Wing Removed), both mirrors (vs Side Mirrors Removed); grille = Bumper Only minus Bumper Grille Removed; bumper shell = Bumper Only minus grille
why: Parts must be the car's own scanned skin so they land back exactly; first mirror cut leaked into the side glass (glass differs between sessions) - zone tightened to |x|>765 mm, y<-225 mm and re-checked by render

decision: Hood opens on a fitted hinge: axis X at y=-0.560 m z=0.833 m (prepped), -40.4 deg = the open hood captured in 'Hood Open' (median 5.6 mm, tools/hinge.py)
why: Hinge from data, not a guess; checked by rendering the hinged hood over the red Hood Open scan (check/hinge.png). First fit scored hood->fragments and failed (51 mm); scoring fragments->hood works because the open capture is partial

decision: Composites (projects/ferrari-296/tools/composite.py): comp_hood = car - hood + Hood Open engine bay; comp_explode = car - bumper/hood/spoiler/mirrors + Bumper and hood removed, Hood Open (z<139 mm lev, drops the propped hood), Rear Wing Removed, Side Mirrors Removed
why: Lessons: use state scans as captured over the trimmed full car; panels lift off to reveal the real scanned structure

decision: Not used: Rear Gas Door Open (fragment of one quarter), crash-foam-removed, air ducting, grille-only and side-mirror part files
why: Gas door is a small partial capture; the others are not on the brief's allowed list (possible Bomex CAD)

decision: Logo: illumaesthetic.com header logo IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png (6135x1059) -> remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png (gitignored)
why: Brief: get it from the website if missing; the site answered with a Cloudflare check once, a browser UA worked

decision: Shot plan (Temerario order): s1 low front 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear 3/4 orbit -> s3 high glide along the right rear haunch/shoulder to the mirror -> s4 headlight/grille close-up -> s5 tail-lamp bar close-up -> s6 hood opens (fitted hinge) -> s7 rise to top-down, nose up -> s8 exploded view (hood, bumper shell, grille, spoiler, mirrors) separate/drift/lock -> logo
why: Brief + reference order; close-ups on 2 mm crops (front2/rear2/side2) per style guide

decision: Wheel close-up dropped; s3 is a high haunch glide where the fender flare hides the wheel
why: At 2 mm the rims are hollow spoke fragments (dark rims scan poorly) - never feature hero areas with holes (Ferrari lesson)

decision: Exploded camera: high front-right 3/4 looking down (r 5.3-5.6 m, h 4.4-3.8 m, az -18 -> -55), panels stack UP: hood +1.45 m, grille +1.0, bumper +0.6, spoiler +0.85, mirrors out 0.45/up 0.35
why: Side-on, fore/aft explosion left 9:16 frame (first test); looking down puts the car's length along the frame height, reference stacks panels above the car

decision: Shots 1-7 rendered 0.4-0.6 s longer than planned; explode rendered after the track arrives
why: Music not here yet: trim to accents in the edit; explode separate/lock must land on measured accents

decision: Look: house silver as rendered, x0.955 gain on scan clips in the edit (colorchannelmixer)
why: Measured vs Temerario.mov (Drive 1BTC6-pMYbJ...): car-pixel median 203/p90 239 (near clip) vs ref 194/227; uniform gain matches without re-rendering

decision: Music: generated track (parent session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield), measured: ~129.6 BPM phonk, quiet 4-bar intro, DROP at 7.43 s (-25 -> -6 dB), heaviest kicks every 8 beats at 8.243+3.692k, last hit 36.97 s, tail to ~38.4 s
why: tools/kicks.py + music_grid.py (kick-band onsets, 0.1 s loudness); the ive beats grid residual was 108 ms because the phonk kick is syncopated

decision: Cuts: 3.70 (intro bar 3), 7.43 drop -> close-ups 7.43/9.28/11.13 (1.85 s each on kick hits), hood 12.97-16.67, top 16.67-19.32, explode A 19.32 (separate on the accent, fully out 23.01), explode B 26.70 (fly home, LOCK on 30.40 = loudest kick), logo 34.09, end 38.4
why: Turntables ride the quiet intro (Temerario fade-up); close-ups start ON the drop; holds vary 1.85-7.4 s; the loudest hit gets the reassembly lock; video ends with the track's tail

decision: Explode split into two camera angles (A high front-right, B high rear-left) on one continuous part timeline
why: 15 s single explode shot is too long for a 130 BPM phonk track; reference also changes angle mid-explode; parts keep their motion across the cut
